champions.name: Aatrox
champions.title: the Darkin Blade
champions.notes: Drain-tank bruiser who wins extended teamfights with Darkin Blade sweetspots and World Ender healing; bullies immobile tanks in lane. Grievous Wounds, kiting ranged tops (Quinn, Kennen) and parry/dash duelists (Fiora, Irelia) blunt him.

champions.name: Ahri
champions.title: the Nine-Tailed Fox
champions.notes: Safe, mobile pick mage: Charm into Spirit Rush finds kills and roams, and she blind-picks into almost any mid. Has no hard counters but is out-roamed by Twisted Fate and all-inned by assassins; wants follow-up CC to convert charms.

champions.name: Akali
champions.title: the Rogue Assassin
champions.notes: Shroud-based skirmish assassin who bursts squishies and resets fights with Perfect Execution; preys on immobile control mages. Point-and-click CC, Galio/Vex/Twisted Fate and true sight inside the shroud shut her down.

champions.name: Akshan
champions.title: the Rogue Sentinel
champions.notes: Roaming marksman-assassin: camouflage, Heroic Swing and the Comeuppance execute snowball skirmishes, and killing an ally's killer revives them. Falls off late; Yasuo's wind wall and sustained melee all-ins beat him in lane.

champions.name: Alistar
champions.title: the Minotaur
champions.notes: Headbutt-Pulverize engage support with a brutal level-2 all-in and a damage-reduction ult to front-line fights; also peels by knocking divers away. Disengage, spell shields and range (Janna, Morgana, Senna, Sona) blunt his engages.

champions.name: Ambessa
champions.title: Matriarch of War
champions.notes: Energy-based dive bruiser whose passive turns every ability into a dash; Public Execution is an unstoppable, point-and-click engage that suppresses a backliner. High pro-priority mid-game skirmisher (top or jungle); kiting ranged tops and lane bullies (Kennen, Tryndamere, Renekton) blunt her all-ins.

champions.name: Amumu
champions.title: the Sad Mummy
champions.notes: Simple, reliable AoE engage tank: Bandage Toss into Curse of the Sad Mummy wins grouped teamfights and punishes clumped comps. Weak early to invading junglers; spell shields, cleanses and disengage (Morgana, Janna) waste his ult.

champions.name: Anivia
champions.title: the Cryophoenix
champions.notes: Zone-control mage with elite waveclear, a wall that splits fights and blocks dives, and an egg passive that makes her hard to kill. Scales into a teamfight anchor and bullies immobile melee tops; long-range mages (Xerath, Syndra), Twisted Fate roams and Sylas stealing Glacial Storm give her trouble.

champions.name: Annie
champions.title: the Dark Child
champions.notes: Point-and-click burst mage whose Flash-Tibbers stun doubles as AoE engage; simple and strong into squishy or melee mids. Short range means long-range mages outpoke her, and she needs frontline to reach fights.

champions.name: Aphelios
champions.title: the Weapon of the Faithful
champions.notes: Weapon-rotation hypercarry with huge AoE teamfight damage (Moonlight Vigil plus Infernum/Chakram) but no mobility. Needs peel or a lockdown support; vulnerable in lane to bullies and poke mages and hunted by divers.

champions.name: Ashe
champions.title: the Frost Archer
champions.notes: Utility marksman: permanent slows, a global Enchanted Crystal Arrow for picks or engage, and scouting Hawkshot; a reliable teamfight follow-up ADC. No mobility, so dive and short-range all-in lanes punish her.

champions.name: Aurelion Sol
champions.title: The Star Forger
champions.notes: Stardust-stacking late-game mage who flies over walls and melts teamfights with Breath of Light, Singularity and a knock-up ult. Very weak early; mobile assassins and melee all-ins (Yone, Fizz, Zed) exploit his lane, so he needs a safe lane and peel.

champions.name: Aurora
champions.title: the Witch Between Worlds
champions.notes: Mobile ranged mage who hops walls and traps enemies inside her Between Worlds zone; kites melee champions well and flexes top/mid. Point-and-click engage and burst (Ambessa, Annie, Akali) and hard-pushing mages give her trouble.

champions.name: Azir
champions.title: the Emperor of the Sands
champions.notes: Late-scaling control mage with sustained soldier DPS, strong siege and a game-changing Shurima Shuffle / Emperor's Divide to peel or flip fights. Weak early and very execution-heavy; LeBlanc, long-range mages and roamers exploit his lane.

champions.name: Bard
champions.title: the Wandering Caretaker
champions.notes: Roaming playmaker support: Cosmic Binding stuns against walls, Magical Journey portals and Tempered Fate create picks or disengage. Excellent in coordinated play (a pro staple); leaves his ADC exposed to 2v1 pressure from engage lanes.

champions.name: Bel'Veth
champions.title: the Empress of the Void
champions.notes: Attack-speed scaling jungler who snowballs off objectives (Void Coral) and shreds in extended skirmishes and side lanes. Point-and-click CC and early tank/CC junglers (Rammus, Sejuani) punish her; needs frontline or engage to fight around.

champions.name: Blitzcrank
champions.title: the Great Steam Golem
champions.notes: Hook-based pick support: one landed Rocket Grab wins lanes and fights, and Static Field silences shields and channels. Punishes immobile enchanters/mages; unreliable vs spell shields and tanky engage supports, and weaker once teams group and ward flanks.

champions.name: Brand
champions.title: the Burning Vengeance
champions.notes: Burn-based AoE mage whose Pyroclasm and Liandry's shred grouped teams and tanks; played as a damage support or mid. Immobile and fragile, so hooks and hard engage punish him; wants CC teammates to set up his combos.

champions.name: Braum
champions.title: the Heart of the Freljord
champions.notes: Premier peel/disengage tank: Unbreakable blocks projectiles and hooks, Concussive Blows stuns win lane trades, Glacial Fissure stops dives. Pair with fast-attacking ADCs; weak into sustained ranged poke he cannot close on.

champions.name: Briar
champions.title: the Restrained Hunger
champions.notes: Frenzied early-game diver with massive self-healing and a long-range fear engage (Certain Death). Snowballs through ganks; loses control in frenzy, so CC and kiting punish her and she falls off if behind.

champions.name: Caitlyn
champions.title: the Sheriff of Piltover
champions.notes: Longest-range lane bully and siege ADC: traps plus headshots win lane and take early towers, ideal for poke/siege comps. Pairs with root supports for trap setups; falls behind hypercarries late and struggles in long fights vs divers.

champions.name: Camille
champions.title: the Steel Shadow
champions.notes: Hookshot dive duelist who isolates a carry with Hextech Ultimatum and scales into a strong split pusher; also a pro-staple engage support. Beats immobile/tanky tops; kiting, blinds and strong early lanes (Teemo, Renekton, Warwick, Gwen) give her trouble.

champions.name: Cassiopeia
champions.title: the Serpent's Embrace
champions.notes: Bootless DPS mage with enormous sustained damage, Miasma grounding vs dashers and an AoE stun ult; excels into melee and dash-heavy lanes and scales very well (strong in pro). Immobile, so she needs peel; long-range mages and divers (Ekko, Qiyana, Fizz) beat her.

champions.name: Cho'Gath
champions.title: the Terror of the Void
champions.notes: Stacking tank whose true-damage Feast also secures objectives; Rupture knock-up and Feral Scream silence give solid teamfight CC. Scales into a huge frontline; %HP and anti-tank champions (Urgot, Trundle, Vladimir) and kiting beat him.

champions.name: Corki
champions.title: the Daring Bombardier
champions.notes: Mixed-damage poke carry with Missile Barrage and The Package; strong mid-game skirmishing and awkward to itemize against. Currently mostly a pro bot-lane pick; outranged by Caitlyn and loses long fights to hypercarries late.

champions.name: Darius
champions.title: the Hand of Noxus
champions.notes: Lane-dominant juggernaut who stacks Hemorrhage and chains Noxian Guillotine resets in teamfights. Brutal early/mid vs melee tops; immobile, so ranged kiters (Quinn, Vayne), slows and disengage beat him, and he falls off late.

champions.name: Diana
champions.title: Scorn of the Moon
champions.notes: AP dive fighter: Moonfall pulls enemies together for an AoE engage and she bursts squishies after chaining Crescent Strike resets; flexes mid/jungle. Kiting and fears (Vex) and strong early duelists beat her; wants AoE follow-up.

champions.name: Dr. Mundo
champions.title: the Madman of Zaun
champions.notes: Near-unkillable scaling tank who shrugs off a CC with his passive and regenerates huge HP with Maximum Dosage; soaks side-lane pressure top or front-lines from the jungle (a pro staple there). Grievous Wounds and %HP/true-damage duelists (Aatrox, Gwen, Camille, Fiora) beat him.

champions.name: Draven
champions.title: the Glorious Executioner
champions.notes: The premier lane-bully ADC: Spinning Axe damage and Adoration cash-outs snowball games, best with engage supports. A coin-flip carry who falls off if denied kills; disengage, sustain and poke lanes stall him.

champions.name: Ekko
champions.title: the Boy Who Shattered Time
champions.notes: Time-rewinding AP skirmisher: fast clears and strong ganks in jungle, burst and waveclear mid, with Chronobreak as heal and escape. Excels vs immobile mages; point-and-click CC, fears and Vladimir/Sylas-style sustain punish his dives.

champions.name: Elise
champions.title: the Spider Queen
champions.notes: Early-game gank and tower-dive specialist: Cocoon stun into spider-form burst, Rappel to dodge tower shots. Must snowball early and falls off; early skirmishers (Talon, Diana) contest her and scaling teams outlast her.

champions.name: Evelynn
champions.title: Agony's Embrace
champions.notes: Stealth assassin who hunts isolated squishies after level 6 and finishes fights with Last Caress. Weak early, so invaders and early skirmishers punish her; Control Wards, Oracle Lens and grouped tanky comps neutralize her.

champions.name: Ezreal
champions.title: the Prodigal Explorer
champions.notes: Safe, mobile poke ADC with Arcane Shift and long-range Mystic Shot; a blind-pick staple in pro play that fits poke/siege comps. Low sustained DPS late; wind walls, projectile blockers and hard-shove waveclear lanes (Sivir) limit him.

champions.name: Fiddlesticks
champions.title: the Ancient Fear
champions.notes: Fog-of-war flanker whose Crowstorm blink wins teamfights on its own when it lands on a grouped team. Needs vision denial and patience; Control Wards, spread positioning and early invaders counter him.

champions.name: Fiora
champions.title: the Grand Duelist
champions.notes: Benchmark split-push duelist: vital true damage and Riposte win 1v1s and take towers, while Grand Challenge heals her team in fights. Tanks and engage that ignore duels (Malphite, Shen) and kiting tops beat her; needs a team that can play 4v4 or stall.

champions.name: Fizz
champions.title: the Tidal Trickster
champions.notes: AP melee assassin: E (Playful/Trickster) dodges key spells and the shark ult one-shots isolated carries from mid game. Best into immobile artillery/control mages; struggles into Vex fear, Kassadin, Vladimir and point-click CC.

champions.name: Galio
champions.title: the Colossus
champions.notes: Anti-magic tank mage: Hero's Entrance follows a diving ally from across the map and W taunts a whole team. Best into AP-heavy comps and with divers (Nocturne, J4, Vi); outscaled and out-ranged by control mages.

champions.name: Gangplank
champions.title: the Saltwater Scourge
champions.notes: Scaling barrel crit carry with global ult pressure; wins by surviving lane and then side-laning and chunking whole teams with barrels. Struggles into durable tanks (Ornn, Mundo) and Kayle's scaling; wants teammates with AoE lockdown to hold enemies on barrels.

champions.name: Garen
champions.title: The Might of Demacia
champions.notes: Simple, durable juggernaut: silence + spin + execute ult. Strong solo-queue side laner who bullies melee duelists; kited by ranged tops (Quinn, Vayne, Teemo), outscaled by Kayle, and lacks hard engage or reliable CC for teamfights.

champions.name: Gnar
champions.title: the Missing Link
champions.notes: Ranged Mini Gnar kites melee in lane, then Mega Gnar ult into a wall is a game-winning multi-man engage. Needs rage management to time fights; pressured by lane bullies that punish Mini form.

champions.name: Gragas
champions.title: the Rabble Rouser
champions.notes: Flex AP bruiser: Body Slam and Explosive Cask reposition enemies into (or out of) fights, making him a top-tier disengage and a solid pick tool. Bullies early-weak scalers (Kayle) and dash-reliant Yasuo; tanky sustain tops (Urgot, Yorick, Mundo) out-trade him.

champions.name: Graves
champions.title: the Outlaw
champions.notes: Farm-heavy carry jungler who out-duels most skirmish junglers, then fights with high burst and bonus armor. Lacks CC, so wants lanes that set up ganks; struggles into armor-stacking tank junglers (Sejuani, Amumu, Rammus) and fast-scaling Karthus.

champions.name: Gwen
champions.title: The Hallowed Seamstress
champions.notes: AP skirmisher with true damage that melts tanks; Hallowed Mist blocks outside damage and turrets. Scales into a strong side-laner and teamfight DPS. Yasuo/Jax-style duelists and ranged tops trouble her; needs frontline/engage to access targets.

champions.name: Hecarim
champions.title: the Shadow of War
champions.notes: Fast-clearing, high-speed diver: E charge plus fear ult runs straight onto the backline. Loves speed/shield enchanters and Orianna ball deliveries; shut down by dash-stoppers (Poppy W), taunts and knockback disengage.

champions.name: Heimerdinger
champions.title: the Revered Inventor
champions.notes: Turret-zone lane bully that punishes melee duelists who must walk into his turrets; strong at holding and sieging chokes. Weak to tanks that shrug off turrets (Sion, Ornn, Malphite), Gangplank barrels and long-range artillery, and loses value in open-map late fights.

champions.name: Hwei
champions.title: the Visionary
champions.notes: Ten-spell control mage: long-range poke, root/fear picks and a zoning ult. Flexes mid/support/bot and scales well; out-ranged by pure artillery (Xerath, Vel'Koz) and immobile against assassins and hard dive.

champions.name: Illaoi
champions.title: the Kraken Priestess
champions.notes: Immobile juggernaut who wins any fight on her tentacles; E (Test of Spirit) and ult punish enemies who dive her. Dominant 1v1 side-laner into melee tanks; ranged kiters (Teemo, Vayne), Kayle and Mordekaiser's ult beat her.

champions.name: Irelia
champions.title: the Blade Dancer
champions.notes: Minion-reset duelist with elite mobility and a strong stun; snowballs through skirmishes once stacked. Wants lanes where she can trade freely; shut down by dash-stoppers, grounding/point-click CC and tanky bruisers.

champions.name: Ivern
champions.title: the Green Father
champions.notes: Enchanter jungler: shields, Daisy and root ganks enable hyper-carries rather than carrying himself. Wants a scaling DPS carry to protect; very weak to early invades and counter-jungling.

champions.name: Janna
champions.title: the Storm's Fury
champions.notes: The premier disengage enchanter: tornado, shield and Monsoon undo dives and engages. Pairs with hyper-carry ADCs in protect-the-carry comps; low kill pressure, slightly outvalued by other enchanters and hook supports in lane.

champions.name: Jarvan IV
champions.title: the Exemplar of Demacia
champions.notes: Pro-staple early-game engage jungler: EQ knock-up ganks and Cataclysm traps enemies for AoE follow-up (MF, Rumble, Orianna). Wants to snowball early objectives; falls off late and is hard-stopped by Poppy W.

champions.name: Jax
champions.title: Grandmaster at Arms
champions.notes: Scaling hybrid duelist: Counter Strike shuts down auto-attackers and melee duelists, and he becomes an elite split-pusher late. Poppy, Garen and ranged/kiting tops (Kennen, Gnar) keep him down; pulls pressure to side lanes rather than starting fights.

champions.name: Jayce
champions.title: the Defender of Tomorrow
champions.notes: Lane bully with elite Shock Blast poke; flexes top/mid and anchors poke/siege comps. Must convert early leads into towers and dragons because he falls off late and struggles into armor-stacking tanks (Malphite, Ornn) and Irelia.

champions.name: Jhin
champions.title: the Virtuoso
champions.notes: Utility marksman with long-range W root, 4th-shot burst and a curtain-call ult that picks off and finishes fights from afar. Pairs well with CC supports that enable his root; immobile, vulnerable to dive, and outscaled by hyper-carries like Zeri.

champions.name: Jinx
champions.title: the Loose Cannon
champions.notes: Hyper-carry ADC whose Get Excited resets turn one takedown into a teamfight wipe; rockets give siege range. Wants peel/enchanter supports and a frontline; immobile, so dive and assassins are her real weakness rather than lane opponents.

champions.name: K'Sante
champions.title: the Pride of Nazumah
champions.notes: Pro-favored tank with elite frontline and a flexible kit: Q3 knock-up, W charge and All Out ult that kicks a carry through a wall to isolate it. Mechanically demanding and weak in solo queue; Kayle, true-damage duelists and sustain tanks beat him in lane.

champions.name: Kai'Sa
champions.title: Daughter of the Void
champions.notes: Hybrid-damage diving ADC: Killer Instinct follows engage-support CC for isolated Icathian Rain bursts. Best with hard-engage supports; out-scaled by range/attack-speed hyper-carries (Zeri, Kog'Maw).

champions.name: Kalista
champions.title: the Spear of Vengeance
champions.notes: Early-game lane bully with hop-kiting mobility, Rend objective control and a Fate's Call throw that turns her support into engage. Wants a hard-engage support and early skirmishes; falls off hard and loses to scaling hyper-carries if the lead stalls.

champions.name: Karma
champions.title: the Enlightened One
champions.notes: Blind-pickable flex enchanter/poke mage: Mantra Q poke dominates lane and team-wide shield + speed enables both disengage and engage. Strongest early; loses value into late-game fights.

champions.name: Karthus
champions.title: the Deathsinger
champions.notes: Farming AP scaler: fast full clears, global Requiem and huge teamfight DPS (even after death). Played jungle or as a bot-lane mage carry; very weak to early invades and dive, so he needs lanes that hold pressure.

champions.name: Kassadin
champions.title: the Void Walker
champions.notes: Hyper-scaling blink assassin: miserable pre-6, then Riftwalk spam at 16 makes him nearly uncatchable and deadly to backlines. Draft him when the team can play for late game; punished hard by early lane bullies and roaming AD assassins.

champions.name: Katarina
champions.title: the Sinister Blade
champions.notes: Reset assassin who cleans up fights with Shunpo/dagger resets and a channelled AoE ult. Needs teammates with AoE engage to start fights she can jump into; hard-countered by point-click CC and interrupts.

champions.name: Kayle
champions.title: the Righteous
champions.notes: The purest late-game hyper-carry: weak melee early, then ranged AoE DPS from 11/16 that shreds everyone. Draft when the team can survive to late; early all-in bruisers and lane bullies punish her pre-6.

champions.name: Kayn
champions.title: the Shadow Reaper
champions.notes: Wall-walking form jungler: Rhaast (vs melee comps) is a sustain drain-tank bruiser, Shadow Assassin (vs ranged comps) is a pick/burst diver. Weak before transforming, so strong early duelists (Bel'Veth, Wukong, Udyr) can deny his scaling.

champions.name: Kennen
champions.title: the Heart of the Tempest
champions.notes: Ranged AP top who kites melee duelists with shuriken poke, then flash-Slicing Maelstrom delivers an AoE stun engage. Great secondary engage for J4/Orianna comps; fragile, and out-sustained by tanky laners (Illaoi, Ornn, Mundo) and Irelia.

champions.name: Kha'Zix
champions.title: the Voidreaver
champions.notes: Isolation-burst assassin jungler who counter-jungles and one-shots lone squishies; evolutions add stealth resets and mobility. Thrives vs immobile, grouped-poorly comps; peel-heavy teams and tanky early junglers blunt him.

champions.name: Kindred
champions.title: The Eternal Hunters
champions.notes: Ranged marksman jungler who scales off marks (invades) and brings Lamb's Respite, a team-wide anti-dive/anti-death ult. Needs early control to stack marks; tanky early duelists (Wukong, Rammus, Sejuani) and Kayn punish her.

champions.name: Kled
champions.title: the Cantankerous Cavalier
champions.notes: Aggressive all-in top laner: bear-trap pull, dismount/remount second life and a long-range Chaaaaaaaarge ult that drags the team into fights. Wants to snowball early and dive; falls off if the lane stalls.

champions.name: Kog'Maw
champions.title: the Mouth of the Abyss
champions.notes: Immobile hyper-carry: Bio-Arcane Barrage %HP on-hit shreds frontline at long range and out-scales early bullies like Kalista. The textbook protect-the-carry pick (Lulu/Janna/Ivern); dies to dive and assassins.

champions.name: LeBlanc
champions.title: the Deceiver
champions.notes: Slippery burst mage/assassin: Distortion trades, chain root picks and Mimic double-combos delete squishies, then escape. Strong mid-game roamer for pick comps; falls off late and is countered by Malzahar/Vex, point-click CC and MR tanks.

champions.name: Lee Sin
champions.title: the Blind Monk
champions.notes: Early-game playmaker: invades, ganks and Insec kicks a carry into his team. Must snowball before tanks and scalers come online; falls off late, Zaahen, Naafiri and Rek'Sai match his early skirmishing, and Taliyah/Ivern out-tempo his ganks.

champions.name: Leona
champions.title: the Radiant Dawn
champions.notes: All-in engage support with a point-and-click stun chain and wide R; wins lane on level 2/3 and sets up picks for the team. Wants a follow-up ADC (Samira, MF, Kalista); hates Janna and Black Shield, and gets out-sustained by Swain, Renata and Soraka lanes.

champions.name: Lillia
champions.title: the Bashful Bloom
champions.notes: Fast-clearing, kiting magic-damage jungler whose AoE sleep R turns messy teamfights. Strong into tank junglers and melee comps; vulnerable to early invaders (Rengar, Rek'Sai, Kha'Zix) and needs frontline/engage allies so she can run circles around the fight.

champions.name: Lissandra
champions.title: the Ice Witch
champions.notes: Anti-dive control mage: point-and-click R, E flanks and W root lock down assassins and divers, then chain into team engage. Excellent into melee mids; outranged by artillery and control mages (Hwei, Viktor, Xerath), and Sylas steals her R.

champions.name: Locke
champions.title: the Ashen Exorcist
champions.notes: Melee AP on-hit assassin (Lich Bane) with a blink-dash E and a Purgatory R that executes and permanently raises its threshold per seal. Feasts on immobile ranged mages (Malzahar, Orianna, Xerath) but has no hard CC and loses to other melee assassins (Akali, Talon, Kassadin).

champions.name: Lucian
champions.title: the Purifier
champions.notes: Short-range lane bully with a dash-reset combo; wants to win lane with an aggressive enchanter (Nami, Milio) or Braum and take early towers. Loses value late vs hypercarries and struggles into APC mage bots (Seraphine, Brand) and long-range poke (Varus, Caitlyn).

champions.name: Lulu
champions.title: the Fae Sorceress
champions.notes: Premier peel enchanter: polymorph, shields and Wild Growth knock-up keep a hypercarry alive through dives. Draft her with an on-hit scaling carry (Kog'Maw, Twitch, Jinx); handles engage and mage supports well but is out-roamed by Bard and punished by Fiddlesticks/Elise/Zoe picks.

champions.name: Lux
champions.title: the Lady of Luminosity
champions.notes: Long-range poke/pick mage: double-root binding into long-range R executes. Best in poke or pick comps with follow-up (Caitlyn traps); immobile, so she is punished by assassins (Locke, Zed), hooks and engage supports like Camille and Pantheon.

champions.name: Malphite
champions.title: Shard of the Monolith
champions.notes: Point-and-click wombo engage with Unstoppable Force; armor stacking and his attack-speed slow crush auto-attack tops (Tryndamere, Vayne, Irelia). Weak into AP and sustained tanks he cannot kill (Sylas, Mundo, Gwen, Mordekaiser, Shen).

champions.name: Malzahar
champions.title: the Prophet of the Void
champions.notes: Safe, push-heavy control mage whose point-and-click suppression R locks down one carry or diver. Great into dash assassins and carries (LeBlanc, Zoe, Yasuo, Master Yi); out-ranged by artillery mages and Smolder, dived by Locke, and Olaf/QSS ignore his R.

champions.name: Maokai
champions.title: the Twisted Treant
champions.notes: Flexible tank with point-and-click root, sapling vision control and a long-range root wave that both starts and stops fights. Low damage, so he needs carries to follow up; loses lane to Zilean, Taric, Braum and Swain, and Nocturne dives him in the jungle.

champions.name: Master Yi
champions.title: the Wuju Bladesman
champions.notes: Farming hypercarry jungler whose resets win late fights against low-CC comps. Needs a free early game and enchanter support; punished by point-and-click CC (Malzahar R, Rammus taunt), Lulu polymorph and early pressure from Zac, Rek'Sai and Elise.

champions.name: Mel
champions.title: the Soul's Reflection
champions.notes: Scaling artillery mage whose Overwhelm stacks execute and whose global R finishes anyone marked; W reflects projectiles (punishes skillshot ults and ranged poke). Currently weak in every role: out-traded by Aurelion Sol, Syndra and Viktor, and dived by Fizz and Locke once W is down.

champions.name: Milio
champions.title: The Gentle Flame
champions.notes: Enchanter whose W extends ally attack range and whose R cleanses CC and heals the whole team; out-sustains mage and Morgana lanes. Pair with range-hungry carries (Jinx, Kog'Maw, Zeri); fragile against hook and all-in engage (Blitzcrank, Nautilus, Amumu).

champions.name: Miss Fortune
champions.title: the Bounty Hunter
champions.notes: Lane-bully ADC with bouncing Q poke and a Bullet Time R that deletes grouped teams. Draft with AoE lockdown (Amumu, Rell, Malphite, Leona) to channel R safely; struggles into APC mages (Viktor, Ziggs, Corki), and Braum E or dive that interrupts R shuts her down.

champions.name: Mordekaiser
champions.title: the Iron Revenant
champions.notes: Immobile AP juggernaut whose Realm of Death isolates a carry 1v1 and turns fights into 4v4. Bullies tanks and immobile bruisers (Illaoi, Tahm, Malphite); kited by Vayne/Singed and outplayed by Yone, Gwen and Fiora, so he needs teammates who win the 4v4.

champions.name: Morgana
champions.title: the Fallen
champions.notes: Anti-engage pick support: Black Shield denies hooks and CC chains while a long Dark Binding catches targets. Hard counter to CC-reliant engage supports; loses lane to enchanter/poke-sustain lanes (Karma, Milio, Janna, Yuumi) and Shaco.

champions.name: Naafiri
champions.title: the Hound of a Hundred Bites
champions.notes: Lethality pack-assassin with a point-and-click dash onto champions and a roaming R; excels at hunting isolated squishies and out-skirmishes Lee Sin/Kha'Zix early. Falls off vs tanky comps and loses to sturdier divers (Hecarim, Nocturne, Bel'Veth, Xin Zhao).

champions.name: Nami
champions.title: the Tidecaller
champions.notes: Aggressive enchanter: bubble, empowered E trades and Tidal Wave give lane pressure, heals and teamfight disengage/engage. Best with multi-hit lane bullies (Lucian, Draven); beats mage supports but is vulnerable to hard engage (Nautilus, Amumu) and anti-heal.

champions.name: Nasus
champions.title: the Curator of the Sands
champions.notes: Stacking juggernaut: weak early, then Siphoning Strike and Fury of the Sands make him a tanky split-pusher and tower-taker; Wither shuts down auto-attack carries. Current sustain lets him survive old ranged-top counters (Vayne, Kennen); durable duelists like K'Sante, Ambessa and Camille handle him best.

champions.name: Nautilus
champions.title: the Titan of the Depths
champions.notes: Tanky hook engage support with point-and-click R and auto-attack root; relentless all-ins and picks into squishy mage/enchanter supports. Pairs with all-in ADCs (Samira, Kalista, Draven, Nilah); loses tank-vs-tank lanes (Taric, Rell, Braum) and Black Shield blunts him.

champions.name: Neeko
champions.title: the Curious Chameleon
champions.notes: Disguise-based engage mage: long root E and a flash-in Pop Blossom AoE stun that wins grouped fights. Needs follow-up AoE (MF, Seraphine); predictable once spotted, beats other engage supports but is poked out by Karma/Zyra and blunted by Black Shield.

champions.name: Nidalee
champions.title: the Bestial Huntress
champions.notes: High-tempo early jungler: fast clear, invades and long-range spear poke into cougar burst. Must convert early leads; falls off late and struggles into tanky, CC-heavy jungles and comps that hard-engage onto her.

champions.name: Nilah
champions.title: the Joy Unbound
champions.notes: Melee skirmish carry who dodges auto attacks with W, shares heals/shields and pulls the enemy in with R. Needs hard-engage or enchanter supports to reach targets; beats auto-attack ADCs (Twitch, Kalista, MF) but is hard-countered by Xayah and ranged mage bots (Corki, Viktor).

champions.name: Nocturne
champions.title: the Eternal Nightmare
champions.notes: Map-wide diver: Paranoia removes vision and lets him drop on an isolated carry, with spell shield and fear for the kill. Combos with global/flank follow-up (TF, Galio, Lissandra); weak when enemies group tightly and into sturdy early duelists (Ambessa, Udyr, Skarner).

champions.name: Nunu & Willump
champions.title: the Boy and His Yeti
champions.notes: Roaming tank jungler: Consume secures objectives and heals, while the snowball roll ganks from long range. Brings engage, frontline and objective control rather than damage; loses tempo to strong early skirmishers and kiting junglers.

champions.name: Olaf
champions.title: the Berserker
champions.notes: Early-game berserker with true-damage E, lifesteal W and a CC-immune R that runs straight at carries. Dominates early skirmishes and CC-heavy comps; falls off late and gets kited by ranged or mobile laners.

champions.name: Orianna
champions.title: the Lady of Clockwork
champions.notes: Scaling control mage: ball-on-diver Shockwave wins teamfights, while shields and Dissonance peel carries. Wants engage teammates to deliver the ball (Malphite, J4, Wukong); weak in lane vs Locke, Irelia and long-range poke (Zoe, Vel'Koz, Xerath).

champions.name: Ornn
champions.title: The Fire below the Mountain
champions.notes: Scaling frontline tank with knock-up engage (R + E) and free item upgrades for his team. Plays safe in lane then anchors teamfights; K'Sante, Fiora and Ambessa out-duel and split-push him.

champions.name: Pantheon
champions.title: the Unbreakable Spear
champions.notes: Flexible early-game bully: point-and-click stun leap, spear poke and a global R for skirmishes and roams. Must snowball the lane or map early; falls off late and struggles against tanky or sustain lanes (Soraka, Taric, Rell, Mundo).

champions.name: Poppy
champions.title: Keeper of the Hammer
champions.notes: Anti-dive tank: Steadfast Presence grounds dashes, Heroic Charge wall-stuns and Keeper's Verdict knocks divers away. Hard-counters dash-reliant champions (Irelia, Jax, Kalista, Yasuo, Lee); low damage, and loses lanes to sustain/poke supports and juggernauts (Darius, Olaf).

champions.name: Pyke
champions.title: the Bloodharbor Ripper
champions.notes: Assassin support: hook, stun dash and resetting execute R snowball through picks and roams. Preys on immobile mage supports (Lux, Xerath, Vel'Koz); provides no frontline or peel, and engage/disengage supports (Renata, Camille, Rakan, Nautilus) blunt him.

champions.name: Qiyana
champions.title: Empress of the Elements
champions.notes: Elemental burst assassin whose terrain-based R stuns whole teams near walls, rivers and brush. Deletes immobile squishies and enables wombo follow-up; needs terrain and leads, and folds to dash-denial (Poppy), Malphite's armor and Rengar/Nidalee early skirmishing.

champions.name: Quinn
champions.title: Demacia's Wings
champions.notes: Ranged lethality skirmisher played jungle or top: bullies melee laners, then uses Behind Enemy Lines for fast rotations, picks and split pressure. Falls off late and is fragile into armor tanks and point-and-click engage.

champions.name: Rakan
champions.title: The Charmer
champions.notes: Mobile engage/peel support: Grand Entrance knockup and The Quickness charm start fights, Battle Dance dashes to shield allies. Best with Xayah and AoE follow-up (Yasuo, Orianna); struggles into Neeko, long-range Senna and dash-stoppers/disengage (Poppy, Janna).

champions.name: Rammus
champions.title: the Armordillo
champions.notes: Powerball gank-and-taunt tank jungler; Defensive Ball Curl punishes auto-attack divers (Rengar, Yi, Tryndamere). Weaker into kiting/early-duel junglers (Lillia, Rek'Sai, Trundle); wants magic-damage allies and follow-up for his engage.

champions.name: Rek'Sai
champions.title: the Void Burrower
champions.notes: Early tunnel ganker with Unburrow knockup and a long-range Void Rush execute; wants to snowball side lanes before tanks outscale. Beats Rammus, Kayn and Briar early but struggles into Sejuani and hard-CC tank junglers.

champions.name: Rell
champions.title: the Iron Maiden
champions.notes: Hard-engage tank support: Crash Down knockup, Full Tilt stun and Magnet Storm pull make her a premier teamfight initiator. Pairs with AoE follow-up (Miss Fortune, Orianna, Samira); weak into drain/disengage supports (Swain, Janna, Neeko) and Poppy W.

champions.name: Renata Glasc
champions.title: the Chem-Baroness
champions.notes: Utility enchanter: Bailout revives aggressive carries and Hostile Takeover turns enemy dive/clumped teamfights on itself. Good vs Pyke and all-in lanes; bullied by long-range mage supports (Vel'Koz, Xerath) and Lulu.

champions.name: Renekton
champions.title: the Butcher of the Sands
champions.notes: Lane-bully bruiser with double dash and empowered W stun; wants to win lane and convert into early dives with his jungler. Falls off late and struggles into sustain/scaling tops (Dr. Mundo, Illaoi, Gangplank), Vayne and Teemo.

champions.name: Rengar
champions.title: the Pridestalker
champions.notes: Bush-leaping one-shot assassin that snowballs picks on squishy carries and squishy junglers. Hard-countered by tanky taunt/CC junglers (Rammus, Sejuani) and Poppy W; needs an early lead to matter.

champions.name: Riven
champions.title: the Exile
champions.notes: High-skill mobile skirmisher with animation-cancel burst and strong split-push; beats immobile bruisers/tanks (Sett, Sion, Yasuo, Gwen). Countered by ranged/stun tops (Kennen, Vayne) and sustain juggernauts (Illaoi, Singed).

champions.name: Rumble
champions.title: the Mechanized Menace
champions.notes: Mech-mage teamfighter: Flamespitter wins trades vs melee and The Equalizer zones whole fights; a high-priority pro flex (top/jungle/mid) that wants CC to lock enemies in the ult. Struggles into Kayle, Gragas and Tahm Kench, and is a weak solo-queue blind.

champions.name: Ryze
champions.title: the Rune Mage
champions.notes: Scaling battlemage with high sustained single-target DPS and Realm Warp for team flanks/escapes; a pro staple but a weak solo-queue lane. Needs time and items; bullied by mobile mids (Irelia, Qiyana, Zoe).

champions.name: Samira
champions.title: the Desert Rose
champions.notes: All-in hypercarry who builds Style to unleash Inferno Trigger; wants hard-engage supports (Nautilus, Leona, Rell, Rakan) and knockups. Wind Wall eats projectiles, but she is kited by long-range/drain mages (Swain, Veigar) and interrupts (Janna, Poppy).

champions.name: Sejuani
champions.title: Fury of the North
champions.notes: Tank engage jungler with Glacial Prison and frost-stun passive; a reliable teamfight initiator and anti-dive frontline that loves melee-heavy allies. Beats snowball assassin junglers (Rengar, Rek'Sai, Kindred, Shaco); weak to kiting magic junglers (Lillia, Diana) and Trundle.

champions.name: Senna
champions.title: the Redeemer
champions.notes: Scaling ranged support/carry: collects Mist for infinite range and AD, heals with Piercing Darkness and global-shields with Dawning Shadow. Wants long-range ADCs; vulnerable to point-and-click engage (Nautilus) and outranged by Xerath.

champions.name: Seraphine
champions.title: the Starry-Eyed Songstress
champions.notes: Scaling teamfight mage (support or bot) with long-range Encore charm engage, AoE shield/heal and solid waveclear. Needs frontline to cast behind; punished by dive/hook supports, Sivir's spell shield and Yasuo's Wind Wall.

champions.name: Sett
champions.title: the Boss
champions.notes: Early/mid-game juggernaut with true-damage Haymaker and The Show Stopper suplex engage; bullies melee lanes and starts fights. Kited by ranged tops (Vayne, Ryze) and outplayed by Riven; falls off vs late-game scalers.

champions.name: Shaco
champions.title: the Demon Jester
champions.notes: Invade-heavy trickster (AD jungle, occasionally AP support) with stealth, Jack in the Box fears and a clone; snowballs early and picks off carries. Falls off late; countered by tanky CC junglers (Sejuani) and strong early duelists.

champions.name: Shen
champions.title: the Eye of Twilight
champions.notes: Global-presence tank: Stand United shields and joins fights anywhere while he split-pushes; Shadow Dash taunt engages and Spirit's Refuge blocks autos. Good vs Fiora, Yorick and tanks; struggles into Quinn, Singed and extended-trade bruisers (Olaf, Sett, Tryndamere).

champions.name: Shyvana
champions.title: the Half-Dragon
champions.notes: Reworked in 26.6: bruiser-tank dragon who farms Scalemail defensive stacks, then engages with the fear-leap Dragon's Descent and brawls with empowered abilities. Needs farm and time; hard-countered by Sylas (steals ult) and weak into Ivern and Udyr.

champions.name: Singed
champions.title: the Mad Chemist
champions.notes: Proxy-farming split-pusher who drags enemies into chases with Poison Trail and flings targets into his team. Frustrates melee tops (Yasuo, Mordekaiser, Riven, Jax); weak into ranged/burst scalers (Gangplank, Kayle, Kennen).

champions.name: Sion
champions.title: The Undead Juggernaut
champions.notes: Scaling HP-stacking tank with long-range Unstoppable Onslaught engage, Decimating Smash knockup and strong side-wave shove; a pro-play staple. Weak lane vs Riven, Yone, Shen and true-damage/ranged tops (Zaahen, Quinn, Gwen).

champions.name: Sivir
champions.title: the Battle Mistress
champions.notes: Waveclear/siege ADC with Spell Shield and team-wide On The Hunt speed; enables fast pushes, engages and disengages. Strong into mage/poke bots (Seraphine, Vel'Koz, Veigar); out-DPSed late by Kog'Maw and Twitch.

champions.name: Skarner
champions.title: the Primordial Sovereign
champions.notes: Tank jungler whose Impale suppresses and drags carries into his team, with Ixtal's Impact wall-stun charges for engage. Strong pick/anti-dive vs Nocturne, Graves and Sylas; weak to kiting and duelist junglers (Udyr, Gwen, Lillia).

champions.name: Smolder
champions.title: the Fiery Fledgling
champions.notes: Stack-scaling dragon ADC: quiet lane, then huge AoE waveclear and max-HP executes vs tanks at high stacks. Needs enchanter protection (Lulu, Milio) and time; long-range mage bots (Lux, Ziggs, Vel'Koz) and Twitch/Zeri out-trade him.

champions.name: Sona
champions.title: Maven of the Strings
champions.notes: Scaling aura enchanter with heals, team speed and an AoE Crescendo stun; strong late-teamfight value. Fragile and immobile, so she needs a bot laner who can hold early pressure and frontline to protect her.

champions.name: Soraka
champions.title: the Starchild
champions.notes: Premier sustain enchanter: Astral Infusion heals and global Wish negate poke and extend fights; Equinox silences. Great vs poke and all-in comps that can't burst through heals; countered by Grievous Wounds and out-traded by Senna and Nami.

champions.name: Swain
champions.title: the Noxian Grand General
champions.notes: Drain-tank battlemage (mostly support/bot, also mid/top) with Nevermove pull-root and Demonic Ascension sustain; wins brawls vs melee/all-in lanes (Rell, Leona, Nautilus, Samira). Kited by long-range mages and enchanters (Syndra, Zeri, Nami, Karma).

champions.name: Sylas
champions.title: the Unshackled
champions.notes: Skirmish mage (jungle or mid) who steals enemy ultimates; his value scales with the enemy's ults (hard-counters Malphite, Shyvana). Struggles into Taliyah, Gwen, Skarner, Pantheon and drain/anti-dash champions.

champions.name: Syndra
champions.title: the Dark Sovereign
champions.notes: Burst/control mage (mid, also bot) with Scatter the Weak stun and point-and-click Unleashed Power execute; strong pick threat and lane control. Vulnerable to mobile assassins that dive past her stun (Fizz, Katarina, Locke).

champions.name: Tahm Kench
champions.title: The River King
champions.notes: Peel tank (support or top): Devour saves carries and grey-health bulk makes him a strong anti-assassin frontline. Beats melee/short-range tops (Irelia, Jayce, Rumble); weak to tanky scalers (Sion, Ornn, Singed) and Gwen's true damage.

champions.name: Taliyah
champions.title: the Stoneweaver
champions.notes: Roaming waveclear mage (mid or jungle): Weaver's Wall splits fights and enables roams, Seismic Shove + Unraveled Earth punish dashers. Strong vs Yasuo/Sylas; weak to assassins (Zed, Katarina, Kassadin, LeBlanc) and long-range Xerath.

champions.name: Talon
champions.title: the Blade's Shadow
champions.notes: Roaming AD assassin with wall-hop parkour; snowballs early picks from jungle or mid and punishes squishy carries. Falls off late; weak vs Rengar, Fiddlesticks and mobile/CC mids (Ekko, Qiyana, Azir).

champions.name: Taric
champions.title: the Shield of Valoran
champions.notes: Protect/dive tank-enchanter: Cosmic Radiance invulnerability and linked Dazzle stuns enable all-ins and dives (Master Yi, Kai'Sa). Weak lane into ranged/poke and anti-engage supports (Senna, Milio, Morgana).

champions.name: Teemo
champions.title: the Swift Scout
champions.notes: Ranged top that blinds auto-attackers (Vayne, Volibear, Renekton, Camille) and zones with Noxious Traps; split-pusher with poor teamfight. Countered by tanky engage and magic damage (Olaf, Sion, Ryze, Akali).

champions.name: Thresh
champions.title: the Chain Warden
champions.notes: Pick-and-peel playmaker: Death Sentence hooks and Flay engage, while Dark Passage lantern saves or repositions allies. Fits almost any comp; best with Kalista/Draven. Mage supports (Brand) and spell shields blunt his hooks.

champions.name: Tristana
champions.title: the Yordle Gunner
champions.notes: Scaling siege ADC with Rocket Jump resets, tower-shredding Explosive Charge and self-peel Buster Shot; all-in capable with engage supports. Strong into immobile mage bots (Vel'Koz, Xerath); struggles vs Nilah and drain/burst mages (Karthus, Veigar, Vladimir).

champions.name: Trundle
champions.title: the Troll King
champions.notes: Early-duel tank-killer: Chomp and Subjugate steal AD/resistances and Pillar isolates targets. Excellent into tank-heavy comps and as a side-lane/skirmish threat; struggles vs ranged kiters (Vayne, Teemo, Quinn) and falls off vs scaled carries.

champions.name: Tryndamere
champions.title: the Barbarian King
champions.notes: Crit split-pusher whose Undying Rage makes him unkillable for 5s; wins through 1-3-1 side pressure that forces two-man answers. Hard-countered by armor/attack-speed-slow tanks (Malphite), Nasus Wither and point-click CC; adds almost no teamfight utility.

champions.name: Twisted Fate
champions.title: the Card Master
champions.notes: Global pick mage: Destiny + Gold Card lets him collapse on side lanes and turn cross-map skirmishes, with strong waveclear to free his lane. Needs follow-up (Nocturne, Galio) and lane priority; loses 1v1 all-ins to Kassadin/Fizz/Yasuo and is blanked by spell shields.

champions.name: Twitch
champions.title: the Plague Rat
champions.notes: Stealth scaling hypercarry: ambushes out of Camouflage and melts front-to-back fights with Spray and Pray's piercing range. Wants an enchanter (Lulu, Yuumi) and peel; weak early and to Windwall, Braum and hard dive.

champions.name: Udyr
champions.title: the Spirit Walker
champions.notes: Stance-swapping juggernaut with fast full clears, strong early duels and run-down ganks via Blazing Stampede's stun. Wants skirmishes and a front-to-back fight; kiting/ranged comps and scaled carries beat him.

champions.name: Urgot
champions.title: the Dreadnought
champions.notes: Ranged juggernaut who wins extended fights with Purge and shotgun-knee passive, flips targets with Disdain and executes with Fear Beyond Death. Beats short-range melee bruisers (Darius, Aatrox); struggles vs armor-stacking tanks and ranged/kiting tops.

champions.name: Varus
champions.title: the Arrow of Retribution
champions.notes: Long-range poke/lethality (or on-hit) marksman: Piercing Arrow sieges, Chain of Corruption starts picks and fights, Hail of Arrows applies Grievous Wounds. Pro staple for poke/pick comps (Karma, Jayce); weaker in hard all-in lanes and vs hyper-scalers late.

champions.name: Vayne
champions.title: the Night Hunter
champions.notes: Tank-shredding hypercarry: Silver Bolts true damage and Tumble/Final Hour stealth make her a late-game 1v5 threat and a duelist top. Weak early lane, short range; needs peel/enchanters (Lulu, Janna) and falls to hard CC, burst and ranged bullies.

champions.name: Veigar
champions.title: the Tiny Master of Evil
champions.notes: Infinitely scaling burst mage: stacks AP from farming and one-shots carries with Primordial Burst, while Event Horizon zones divers. Weak early and to mobile assassins (Katarina, LeBlanc); pairs with AoE engage that shoves enemies into the cage.

champions.name: Vel'Koz
champions.title: the Eye of the Void
champions.notes: Artillery mage with the longest reliable poke and true-damage passive that also punishes tanks; Life Form Disintegration Ray shreds grouped teams. Immobile: needs frontline/disengage and loses to hooks (Blitzcrank) and assassins that reach him.

champions.name: Vex
champions.title: the Gloomist
champions.notes: Anti-mobility burst mage: Gloom punishes dashes and Personal Space/Doom fear dive, making her a premier counter to Yasuo, Yone, LeBlanc and Akali. Good waveclear and R follow-up on picks; outranged by immobile artillery mages (Xerath, Hwei) and out-sustained by Vladimir.

champions.name: Vi
champions.title: the Piltover Enforcer
champions.notes: Dive/pick jungler: Cease and Desist is an unstoppable point-and-click lockdown on the priority carry, great for starting fights and securing picks; strong gank pressure. Weaker into peel/kite comps and early duelists (Warwick, Zac).

champions.name: Viego
champions.title: The Ruined King
champions.notes: Reset-based skirmisher: possessing kills chains fights and heals him, snowballing messy teamfights. Needs early leads and chaotic fights; struggles vs early duelists (Warwick), heavy chain-CC and disciplined front-to-back comps.

champions.name: Viktor
champions.title: the Herald of the Arcane
champions.notes: Scaling control mage: Hextech Ray waveclear/poke, Gravity Field zone-stun and Arcane Storm give strong teamfight zone once Hex Fragment augments come online; also flexes bot as a lane-bully mage. Immobile, so vulnerable to longer-range mages (Xerath) and assassins.

champions.name: Vladimir
champions.title: the Crimson Reaper
champions.notes: Self-sustaining AP scaler: Transfusion healing and Sanguine Pool make him hard to kill, and Hemoplague bursts grouped enemies late. Weak pre-6/early levels; hates Grievous Wounds, long-range control mages (Malzahar) and early lane bullies top.

champions.name: Volibear
champions.title: the Relentless Storm
champions.notes: Early-game dive juggernaut: Thundering Smash stun, Frenzied Maul healing and Stormbringer tower-disable let him dive backlines and towers. Snowballs early; weak to kiting/ranged tops (Teemo, Quinn) and scales poorly.

champions.name: Warwick
champions.title: the Uncaged Wrath of Zaun
champions.notes: Drain-tank early ganker: Blood Hunt tracks low-HP targets and Infinite Duress suppresses a carry for follow-up; wins early duels and 2v2s with self-healing. Falls off late; hates Grievous Wounds, Rammus and kiting junglers.

champions.name: Wukong
champions.title: the Monkey King
champions.notes: Bruiser-diver whose double-cast Cyclone knocks up clumped enemies; strong ganks with W stealth and E dash. Combos with knock-up follow-up (Yasuo, Yone) and wombo mages; wants engage angles, not kiting comps.

champions.name: Xayah
champions.title: the Rebel
champions.notes: Teamfight marksman with built-in anti-dive: Featherstorm's untargetability and Bladecaller's feather root punish divers and all-ins (Samira, Kai'Sa). Best with Rakan; outscaled by Jinx and poked out by long-range mages (Hwei, Lux).

champions.name: Xerath
champions.title: the Magus Ascendant
champions.notes: Premier artillery mage: extreme-range poke and Rite of the Arcane siege objectives and whittle teams before fights. Immobile and squishy — needs frontline/disengage and lane priority; hard-punished by assassins (Fizz, Katarina, Kassadin) and engage supports.

champions.name: Xin Zhao
champions.title: the Seneschal of Demacia
champions.notes: Early skirmish diver: Audacious Charge engage, Three Talon Strike knockup and Crescent Guard (blocks ranged damage) win early fights and dives. Pro-favored ball-carrier for Orianna; falls off late and loses to strong early duelists (Udyr, Sylas).

champions.name: Yasuo
champions.title: the Unforgiven
champions.notes: Crit skirmisher with double crit chance, Wind Wall vs projectiles and Last Breath off any airborne effect. Draft knock-ups (Malphite, Yone, Wukong, Alistar); countered by point-click/anti-dash control (Vex, Lissandra, Taliyah) and early armor bullies.

champions.name: Yone
champions.title: the Unforgotten
champions.notes: Mixed-damage crit skirmisher: Spirit Cleave dashes/knockups and Fate Sealed give AoE engage, while Soul Unbound lets him dive and return. Hard to itemize against; countered by anti-dash control (Vex) and early duelists (Irelia, Olaf, Jax).

champions.name: Yorick
champions.title: Shepherd of Souls
champions.notes: Side-lane siege engine: ghouls and the Maiden of the Mist shred towers and win 1v1s, forcing multiple defenders. Team should play 4v4 with waveclear/disengage; weak to AoE-clearing duelists (Yone, Gwen) and Shen's cross-map answers.

champions.name: Yunara
champions.title: the Unbroken Faith
champions.notes: On-hit/crit scaling marksman with hybrid (magic on-hit) damage; Cultivation of Spirit splashes attacks into grouped enemies and Transcend upgrades her W laser and E into a dash. Weak to dive when R is down and to early lane bullies; wants peel/enchanters and front-to-back fights.

champions.name: Yuumi
champions.title: the Magical Cat
champions.notes: Attach-and-heal enchanter: untargetable while attached, providing heals, move speed and stats to a hypercarry. Weak lane presence and low CC; loses to engage supports (Alistar, Thresh) and Grievous Wounds; best on scaling on-hit carries.

champions.name: Zaahen
champions.title: The Unsundered
champions.notes: Darkin drain-juggernaut who wins long fights: Determination stacks grant AD and eventually a revive, with heals on Q and R; Q-recast knockup and W pull give catch. Bullies level 1 and scales into an unkillable late-game frontline; weak to ranged/kiting tops (Teemo, Vayne, Quinn) that keep trades short.

champions.name: Zac
champions.title: the Secret Weapon
champions.notes: Long-range engage tank: Elastic Slingshot starts fights from fog and over walls, with blob heals and a passive revive keeping him in the fight. Premier engage for AoE follow-up comps; weak to Grievous Wounds, kiting and early invade/duel junglers.

champions.name: Zed
champions.title: the Master of Shadows
champions.notes: Shadow assassin: Death Mark one-shots isolated squishies and shadows give elusive side-lane pressure. Pick/split win condition; poor into tanky or armor-stacking comps (Malphite), Zhonya's and point-click lockdown.

champions.name: Zeri
champions.title: The Spark of Zaun
champions.notes: Hyper-mobile scaling marksman: Spark Surge wall-hops and Lightning Crash move speed let her kite and chain fights. Needs enchanter support (Lulu, Yuumi) and farm; weak early lane vs bullies and to hard CC.

champions.name: Ziggs
champions.title: the Hexplosives Expert
champions.notes: Siege artillery mage: Satchel Charge/Hexplosive bombs demolish towers and waves, and Mega Inferno Bomb pokes from across the map. Wins by taking objectives early; needs frontline/disengage and is punished by assassins and hard dive.

champions.name: Zilean
champions.title: the Chronokeeper
champions.notes: Utility mage: double-bomb AoE stun, Time Warp speed/slow and Chronoshift revive make him a flexible disengage/peel and chase support. Chronoshift blanks assassin burst on the carry; scales with levels and wants a hypercarry to protect.

champions.name: Zoe
champions.title: the Aspect of Twilight
champions.notes: Long-range burst/pick mage: Sleepy Trouble Bubble into Paddle Star one-shots squishies and wins sieges through fog. High skill ceiling; weak to divers/assassins and Malzahar/Annie in lane, and to tanky comps she can't burst.

champions.name: Zyra
champions.title: Rise of the Thorns
champions.notes: Plant-mage zone controller: Grasping Roots and plants poke and punish melee, and Stranglethorns is a strong AoE knockup/zone in teamfights; also a fast-clearing ganky jungler. Immobile; vulnerable to hooks and hard engage.
